hank_bio: Born and raised in the Lowcountry, studying Business and Aviation. Hank believes in doing it right the first time, bringing the same care and precision to every tree as he would to his own home.
jacob_bio: Charleston native and UGA Finance and Real Estate major. Always early to the job, Jacob lives by "slow and steady wins the race," taking the extra time to get every tree perfect.
about_intro:
I'm Hank, and this is Jacob. We are two longtime friends who decided to build something real in our hometown. Born and raised in Charleston, we started with a truck, a strong work ethic, and a genuine love for making Christmas easier for the families and businesses we serve.

We run every job personally, handling many of the deliveries ourselves and working alongside a trained local crew on the rest. No subcontractors and no call center, just two friends who care about doing it right. When you call us, you're talking to the people whose names are on the truck.
